name: Freedom Arrow — 0.9 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.9: China (PLA) on the full 0.7.0-dev.58 game. 0.9.1-dev.1 (19 Nov): first build of the 0.9.1 playtest line. Nukes cost about a third more (MiG-31K (S) 2000, B-2/B-21 B61 1850, B-1B B61 and Tu-160 Kh-102 1350, DF-31A 1350); AMRAAM-class missiles burn 4.5 s, B-21 JATM = AIM-260 motor, R-37 accuracy 1.0; JRVG-1 HE no longer hits tank roofs; mod lobby list connects through freedomarrow.app (works from mainland China). Includes everything in 0.9.0-dev.44. Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.47.
